page.overview:
Who is Rubicante?

Rubicante is a voidsent who serves as a character and boss in Final Fantasy XIV: Endwalker. Formerly an Au Ra Memoriate from the Thirteenth reflection of the Source, he, like all denizens of the star, was consumed by the Flood of Darkness which rendered him into an aether-starved beast known as a voidsent. As a voidsent, he served Golbez as his archfiend of fire.

Before being known as Rubicante, he was a solemn mage who trained in fire magic with his brother mage. Living in Mount Ordeals, they both honed their magical skills to be unbeatable. Due to the Contramemoria, fiends began to descend on nearby villages, which galvanized the mages into action, using their mastered flames for the salvation of the world.

Arriving at a nearby village, the pair vanquished many fiends until only one remained. The brother mage prepared to strike it down but hesitated because of the words of a little girl, whose mother had turned into the fiend. Due to his hesitation he was struck down. Unsure of what to do, the man who would be known as Rubicante hesitated as well until he saw the creature go after the little girl. Using his powers as a Memoriate, he flung his wand at the creature, turning it into a memoria crystal.

Frustrated at his inability to save a life, much less the world, his face turned red in both anger and from his flames, earning him the name Rubicante from the little girl. Taking his comrade to the mountain, he buried him and etched in his tombstone admonishments and returned to training in solitude. One day Rubicante discovered the memoria crystal placed on his comrade's tombstone by the little girl and he regained his resolve to attempt to save the world..|name=Shadowed Pasts Once More}}
